mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically precedes a downturn in economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of periods with declining GDP, or the correlation between GDP growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in real personal savings signals a shift in consumer behavior towards spending, boosting economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and RSAFS decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a single month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPI below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, leading to increased investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of periods with low CPI, or the correlation between low CPI and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP and increase in unemployment rate signals a weakening demand environment coupled with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases and UNRATE increases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of GDPC1 and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
